Connected.

A course booked doesn't just sit in a diary — it flows all the way through to payment. Courses can be uploaded and invoiced directly from your dashboard — scheduling, instructor pay and accounts, all built to talk to each other.

Course booked→Instructor assigned→Learners enrolled→Paperwork submitted→Instructor timesheet, via My Pay→Invoice raised in Xero or QuickBooks→Paid status synced back

Explore Digital Training Centre

Admin, assessment and IQA

One home screen for course admin, instructor admin, job scheduling, LMS overview and workbook marking — everything a manager needs, at a glance.

  • Live counts — needs your review, awaiting IQA, courses this year
  • Your next job front and centre, with one tap into My Schedule
  • Quick actions — start a live quiz, run a scenario, log CPD

Job Scheduling

Create a course, pick its days, put instructors on each day — then run timesheets and mark payments, all from the same calendar.

  • A month-view calendar of every course and who's confirmed on it
  • Instructors marked as lead, with confirmed status per day
  • Feeds straight into timesheets, pay requests and CPD hours

Course Matrix

Every course's paperwork in one place — learners, skills stations, scenario sessions, theory exams and QA, building towards a complete course pack.

  • Learners sign the register by scanning a QR code on their own phone
  • Course details, instructors and days taught, all on one tab
  • Everything rolls up into a single course pack, ready to submit

Deliver, capture, assure

Scenario cards, live scenario running, scene sound and kit tracking — everything an instructor needs on the day, in one place.

  • Briefs, role-player cards and assessment criteria for every scenario
  • Guided scenario running — safety, roles, sound and assessment together
  • Live scene sound mixer to add realism, controlled from the tablet
  • Track medical training kit by location, service dates and consumables

Asset management function

Every asset, service date and consumable tracked in one list, so nothing goes missing and nothing runs out mid-course.

  • Track medical training kit by location, service dates and consumables
  • Flags overdue servicing and low stock before it becomes a problem
  • One list shared across instructors, cohorts and locations

Admin and learner views, side by side

Every learner and cohort at a glance for your team, and a clean, focused dashboard for learners themselves.

  • A colour-coded question matrix — passed, awaiting marking, referred, started
  • Learners see only their own courses, in a simple tile dashboard
  • Progress updates automatically as learners submit and instructors mark

Knowledge Centre & QR quizzes

Live quizzes learners play on their own phones, plus hand-outs and course documents in one place.

  • QR Game Board Quiz — live quizzes learners play on their phones
  • Hand Outs — course documents and links, with QR codes to download
  • Resource Centre for manufacturer hand-outs, coming soon

Instructor CPD centre

A rolling record of teaching, assessment and learning, built from the courses instructors actually deliver — ready for external quality assurance.

  • Hours recorded over the last 3 years, logged automatically
  • CPD Learning — study sessions, videos, resources and quizzes, coming soon
  • Individual logins, so every instructor's record is their own

Built with our development team, to suit your exact requirements

Scoped and quoted around your course — as much or as little structure as you need.
